name: pitmaster
description: The pitmaster skills plugin by Writerblockade.

plugins.name: pitmaster
plugins.description: Grill the plan before it starts (bbq), record decisions as ADRs (makeadr), talk a subject through and write down what was decided (talk-through), let several agents argue a decision out (townhall), let the agent pick the work (dealers-choice) under standing authority (carte-blanche) and carry a settled plan into the build (goforit), pick the models (tier-select) and the budget (budget-select), check what limits your other models (neighbour-check), log what it cost (spend-ledger), find the bottleneck (swarm-bottleneck), audit blind whether it is ready for strangers (tastetest), find what was left unfinished (looseends), run release day (setfree), and prep a project for agents (project-prep).
